name: Bambinos.live - Zero-Touch Student Renewal & Class Scheduling Automation

parameters.query: SELECT s.student_id, s.user_id, s.student_name_masked, s.parent_name_masked, s.registered_mobile_masked, s.current_classbatch_id, s.classbatch_name, s.class_id, s.class_name, s.educator_id, s.educator_name, s.standard_fee_24_sessions_inr, s.batch_days, s.batch_start_time, s.active_students_count, s.max_batch_size FROM reference_active_batches_and_students s WHERE s.student_id = :student_id;

parameters.text: =Resolve entity match between Invoice Payer: {{$node["Normalize Webhook Payload"].json["payer_mobile"]}} ({{$node["Normalize Webhook Payload"].json["payer_name"]}}) and Student Master: {{$json["registered_mobile_masked"]}} ({{$json["parent_name_masked"]}}). Return JSON with match_confidence, resolved_phone, and discrepancy_reason.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO booking_requests (faculty_form_id, invoice_id, user_id, student_id, class_id, educator_id, classbatch_id, sessions_count, is_renewal, continue_same_batch, request_status, batch_allocated, allocated_by, allocated_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (NULL, :invoice_id, :user_id, :student_id, :class_id, :educator_id, :classbatch_id, 24, 'Yes', 'Yes', 'Completed', 'Yes', 'ai_auto_approval_engine', NOW(), NOW(), NOW());

INSERT INTO class_schedule_bookings (bookingrequest_id, invoice_id, classschedule_id, classbatch_id, class_id, user_id, student_id, educator_id, class_date, start_time, end_time, booking_type, is_cancelled, attended_class, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:bookingrequest_id, :invoice_id, UUID(), :classbatch_id, :class_id, :user_id, :student_id, :educator_id, :class_date, :start_time, :end_time, :booking_type, 'No', 'No', NOW(), NOW());

parameters.text: =✅ Student Renewal Auto-Approved: {{$node["Lookup Student & Batch Master"].json["student_name_masked"]}} renewed 24 sessions in {{$node["Lookup Student & Batch Master"].json["classbatch_name"]}} with {{$node["Lookup Student & Batch Master"].json["educator_name"]}}.
